title: Jingle Bells: How Sleigh Runners Glide Across Packed Snow!

lines.text: Jingle bells, jingle bells, jingle all the way! Oh what fun it is to ride in a one-horse open sleigh!
lines.caps: Jingle *BELLS, | jingle bells, jingle all the *WAY! | Oh what fun it is to ride in a *ONE-HORSE | open *SLEIGH!

lines.text: How does a heavy wooden sleigh glide smoothly across soft snow without sinking in?
lines.caps: How does a heavy wooden *SLEIGH | glide smoothly across soft *SNOW | without sinking *IN?

lines.text: If you used thin bike wheels, the heavy weight would sink right into the snowbank!
lines.caps: If you used thin bike *WHEELS, | the heavy weight would sink *RIGHT | into the *SNOWBANK!

lines.text: But sleigh runners are long, smooth, and gently curved upward at the front!
lines.caps: But sleigh runners are *LONG, | smooth, and gently curved *UPWARD | at the *FRONT!

lines.text: They spread the weight across the snow so the sleigh floats on top of the powder!
lines.caps: They spread the *WEIGHT | across the snow so the sleigh *FLOATS | on top of the *POWDER!

lines.text: As the runner slides, tiny friction melts a microscopic film of slippery water!
lines.caps: As the runner *SLIDES, | tiny friction melts a microscopic *FILM | of slippery *WATER!

lines.text: The sleigh hydroplanes across the snow like a speedboat across a lake!
lines.caps: The sleigh hydroplanes across the *SNOW | like a speedboat across a *LAKE!

lines.text: Now you know the winter engineering behind Jingle Bells!
lines.caps: Now you *KNOW | the winter *ENGINEERING | behind Jingle *BELLS!

lines.caps: *RING in the holiday | fun and *SUBSCRIBE | to *BABYBEATS | *RHYMO!
